test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some desktops are monitors.

No monitor is a television.

Conclusions:

(I) Some desktops are televisions.

(II) Some monitors are desktops.
solution:
Given Statements:

Some desktops are monitors.

No monitor is a television.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd7e96f3c821c29462a750e1e381c4b036319b8497739986e6c42f8920310214.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0705609023358a45ce71fbb7dffe4bca23cf6f42bf4527e038419d8da84e963.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some desktops are televisions - Does not** ****f****ollow****.** (There's no direct relation between desktops and televisions.It's a possibility, but not a definite conclusion.)

II. Some monitors are desktops - Follow. (The statement "Some desktops are monitors" directly implies that if some desktops fall into the category of monitors, then it must also be true that some monitors are desktops.)

**So, only conclusion II follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
